sargent.line: I liked the John Singer Sargents.
stanza: I looked at the Rubens and Rembrandts,
I liked the John Singer Sargents.
He told me he liked Turner
Never have I turned since then
No, never have I turned to any other man

sergeant.line: Full speed ahead it is, Sergeant
stanza: Full speed ahead, Mister Boatswain, full speed ahead
Full speed ahead it is, Sergeant
Cut the cable! Drop the cable!
